what: Episodes excluded from aim metrics, the BC baseline, RL rewards/updates and any training/DAgger dataset because a human input reached the game while the pad was attached (missed takeover). Source: live-loop's audit of sittings 01-07 (D:/rivals-agent-local/takeover-sitting07-20260930/sittings01-07-audit.json, raw key/button/motion packets inside each episode's window; 27 other covered episodes had none). Whole episodes are excluded, not spans.

episodes.data/calibration/rl-sitting-20260930-07/: 13 key downs + 404 motion packets (James pressed D/Space/S at 18:59:03-06)

contaminated_bundles.data/calibration/rl-sitting-20260930-07/: online AWR after episode 15, which includes ep-015-rl

contaminated_bundles_note: Never start from or evaluate these bundles as RL progress. Episodes ep-017-rl and ep-019-rl were driven by them: they are not RL learning-curve evidence, but their frames stay valid as policy-visited frames (aim metrics, DAgger inputs), since no human input reached the game in them.
